note.text: Every vendor comparison deck leans on a benchmark score the vendor itself ran, scored, and selected. Self-reported numbers are marketing with decimal points, not evidence, because the prompts, the retries, and the cherry-picked runs never make it into the slide. A model worth buying should survive the same test, administered the same way, with every prediction published for anyone to check. Procurement that can't reproduce a score shouldn't be trusting it.
